text: dsh-plugin-node-time 是一款面向 DSH Web 的会话节点时间提示插件。它通过浏览器端悬停浮层读取当前会话快照，为工具调用、Think 与 assistant step 显示开始和结束时间、运行耗时及可用的首 token 时间；命令、压缩标记和错误等节点显示事件时间。正在运行的步骤会刷新耗时，时间按本地时区格式化。适合想快速查看单条会话节点耗时的 DSH Web 用户，通过 Web profile 安装，无需额外密钥或外部服务。

dsh-plugin-node-time adds timestamp tooltips to DSH Web chat nodes. Hover over tool calls, Think rows, or assistant steps to see times and duration. Supported events show their event time; running durations refresh in local time. Install in the Web profile.
想在 DSH Web 里查看每条工具调用花了多久？
悬停 Think 或 assistant step 时显示开始、结束和首 token 时间。
让我快速查看 Bash、Read、Edit 等会话节点的运行耗时。
DSH 会话里命令和压缩事件发生在什么时候？
Show me the start time and duration of each tool call in DSH Web.
I want to inspect timestamps for Think steps and chat events.
dsh-plugin-node-time 的功能「工具调用计时」：悬停工具行或 Bash sample 卡片，按调用 ID 查找对应调用及嵌套子调用，并展示开始、结束时间和耗时。
dsh-plugin-node-time 的功能「步骤时间」：悬停 Think 或 assistant step 行，显示步骤起止时间、运行耗时，并在快照提供首 token 时间时附上 TTFT。
dsh-plugin-node-time 的功能「事件时间」：悬停命令、压缩、重试或错误等支持的聊天节点，查看该事件的单点时间；无对应快照数据时不显示卡片。
想知道某个 DSH 工具调用从开始到返回经历了多长时间。
Can I see when a DSH chat event happened without opening details?

dsh-plugin-node-time README · dsh-plugin-node-time：Hover timestamps for DSH web. Hovering a chat node row — Think, Bash, Read/Edit/Write, Search, commands, compaction markers, sub-calls — pops a compact card with that node's start time → end time and how long it took.

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

[](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/focksor/dsh-plugin-node-time)

dsh-plugin-node-time README · The card：- **Range line** — start → end in your local timezone; the date prefix appears when the node didn't happen today (and the year when it wasn't this year). A still-running node shows `start → …` with the elapsed time ticking every second; the line flips to the final range the moment the call settles.
- **Duration line** — humanized: `830ms` / `4.33s` / `1m 23s` / `1h 02m 30s`.
- **Extra line** — assistant steps also show `TTFT` (time to first token) when the step has recorded one.
- **Styling** rides the host's `--dsw-alias-*` design tokens, so it follows your theme; the card is `pointer-events: none` and never intercepts the mouse.

dsh-plugin-node-time README · What gets a card：| Row | Start | End |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Tool rows (Bash, Read, Edit, Search, …) and every nested sub-call | tool/call time | tool/result time |
| Think rows and assistant steps | step/start time | assistant/message time |
| Commands, compaction, turn errors, retries, context rows | — | event time (single line) |

dsh-plugin-node-time README · What gets a card：Rows whose times the host already shows on hover (user messages, the turn tail) are left untouched, and a node whose call event fell outside the loaded history window simply shows what exists — or nothing.

dsh-plugin-node-time README · How it works：- **Trigger** — one delegated `mouseover`/`mouseout` pair on `document` (capture). A hit on a row header — `[data-disclosure-row]` (generic tool rows, Think, commands) or `[data-sample]` (the Bash/Pwsh sample card, whose expanded output lives outside the row root, so sweeping output never pops the card) — resolves through `data-chat-call-id` (exact tool-call/sub-call attribution) or `data-chat-anchor-key` (chat node), then reads the timing out of the current session snapshot — read at hover time, so it is always fresh.
- **Data** — the `sessions` service: `ToolChatData.root` lifecycle (`callTime`/`time`), `AssistantChatData.finalNode.timing` (`stepStartTime`/`firstTokenTime`/`completedTime`), `node.location.step` boundary events for running steps, and `data.time` for single-time nodes.
- **Zero host DOM writes** — the card is a `position: fixed` element appended to `document.body`; React re-renders can never wipe it, and no host component is replaced or patched.
- **Style contract** — the injected `<style>` arrives pre-tagged with `data-plugin="dsh-plugin-node-time"`: the client module system's `claimStyles` re-assigns every *untagged* hea

dsh-plugin-node-time README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-node-time
```

Restart `dsh web` to take effect.

dsh-plugin-node-time README · From source (local development)：```bash
pnpm install
pnpm run build
pnpm test
```

Then add this package to `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json` as a `link:` dependency, register it in `dsh.profile.bundles`, and restart `dsh web`.
